events.description: RFI with S/C CAPELLA-19 ACADIA @ 03:20:35 UTC, with impact on datatakes S1D-25912 and S1D-25913. Data recovery initiated.

events.title: S2A: Compression anomaly detected

events.title: S3A OLCI: Calibration pending
events.description: OLCI calibration activity scheduled. Expected to complete within 48 hours. No data loss expected.

events.title: S1A: Satellite manoeuvre
events.description: Scheduled orbit correction manoeuvre. Acquisition suspended for 2 hours. No datatakes lost.

events.title: S5P: INU processor error — very long description to test collapsible rendering and wrapping behavior in the calendar widget interface
events.description: The INU (Instrument Neutral Unit) processor encountered an out-of-memory condition while processing a large datatake sequence. The condition was resolved by increasing the memory allocation for the processor. A full reprocessing of the affected datatakes was initiated on 2026-06-29 and is expected to complete by 2026-06-30. This is a detailed technical description that may be quite lengthy and should be displayed with a collapsible/expandable UI to avoid cluttering the calendar view.

events.title: S2C: Acquisition station downlink issue
events.description: Ground station in Kiruna reported packet loss during S2C pass. One datatake incomplete, reacquired on next pass.
